BlueprintConnectionRefRequest.description:
A consumer-anchored wire (map value; keyed by the consumer input key).

The value names only the producer end (``fromRole`` / ``fromOutput``); the
consumer end is derived from the enclosing node (``toRole`` = the node name)
and the map key (``toInput``). One wire per consumer input (inbound-uniqueness,
enforced by the publish gate).

fromOutput.description: Declared output key on the producer component.
fromOutput.title: Fromoutput

fromRole.description: Node name of the producer component.
fromRole.title: Fromrole

BlueprintConnectionRefRequest.title: BlueprintConnectionRefRequest

charset.title: Charset

encoding.description: Encoding applied to the random bytes: HEX, BASE64, BASE64URL, or ALPHANUMERIC.
encoding.title: Encoding

SeedBlueprintNodeRequest.description:
One graph node (map value keyed by node name) — the seed-local ref form.

The public-wire node (``BlueprintComponentRefRequest``) references a
Component by ``componentId`` + ``componentVersion``; a seed item has no ids
yet, so this node references the sibling ``components/<name>.yaml`` file by
``component`` (its stem) instead. Every other field (``size``,
``advanced``, ``connections``) is the wire model's, reused verbatim — the
field-set relationship is drift-gated in
``tests/unit/seeds/test_catalog_manifest_drift.py``.

advanced.description: Optional advanced compute pins that narrow the eligible-host set at schedule time (ADR 0095).

component.description: Stem of the sibling components/<name>.yaml file this node deploys. The pinned version comes from that file's metadata.version.
component.title: Component

connections.description: Inbound wires for this node, keyed by the consumer input key each fills (value names the producer role and output; one wire per input).
connections.title: Connections

size.description: Compute Profile slug bound to this node, such as general.standard.small. Required per node — the Component carries no compute of its own (ADR 0092).
size.title: Size

SeedBlueprintNodeRequest.title: SeedBlueprintNodeRequest

SeedBlueprintSpecRequest.description:
The ``spec`` block of a blueprint document — mirrors ``BlueprintSpecRequest``.

``parameters`` empty means the importer derives the install-form parameters
from the graph's merged USER-supplied inputs (the standard path); a
non-empty map is an authored override lowered verbatim.

components.description: Component references composing the graph, keyed by graph-local node name.
components.title: Components

parameters.description: Authored install-form parameter overrides, keyed by parameter key. Empty means the importer derives parameters from merged USER inputs.
parameters.title: Parameters
